BiblicalUsage: Omri is the king of Israel who reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah, beginning in the thirty-first year of Asa in 1 Kings 16:23. The same chapter says in 1 Kings 16:25 that Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all that were before him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Omri's twelve years are a warning that a long reign is not a good reign, and doing worse than all before him is a legacy no king should want.
